mapper.sql: verificationId, phone, code, expiresAt, usedAt, attemptCount, createTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO phone_verification(phone, code, expiresAt, usedAt, attemptCount, createTime) VALUES (#{phone}, #{code}, #{expiresAt}, #{usedAt}, #{attemptCount}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM phone_verification WHERE phone = #{phone} AND usedAt IS NULL AND expiresAt > #{now} ORDER BY verificationId DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM phone_verification WHERE phone = #{phone} ORDER BY verificationId DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE phone_verification SET attemptCount = attemptCount + 1 WHERE verificationId = #{verificationId} AND usedAt IS NULL
